messages.content: I mixed up a meeting time and kept Priya waiting for twenty minutes. Write a sincere apology that takes responsibility and offers to reschedule, without making excuses.
Describe a small seaside bakery opening before dawn, in one vivid paragraph.
Explain to a beginner why copying a nested Python list with copy() does not make the inner lists independent. Show an example and two ways to fix it. Keep the explanation friendly and concrete.

Write Python code for merge_intervals(intervals): accept unsorted (start, end) pairs, merge overlaps and touching endpoints, and return a new sorted list of tuples. Leave the input untouched. Include tests for empty input, nested intervals, and touching intervals. Explain the algorithm and its complexity.

A service receives 120 requests per second. One worker processes 18 requests per second, but we want at least 25% spare processing capacity above that incoming load. How many workers are needed? Explain the calculation and check your answer.

Help me plan a database migration. The new code must work with both the old and new schema; backfilling takes hours; old application instances may stay alive during deployment; and we need a rollback path. Give a practical sequence and say when it is safe to remove the old column.
